description: The chart compares the distribution of three categories across three different datasets, with each dataset represented by a pie chart. Each pie chart is divided into three slices, labeled as "W/o Demos" (grey), "Hard to Tell" (blue), and "W/ Demos" (green). The top chart has slices representing 43.0% (W/o Demos), 22.9% (Hard to Tell), and 34.1% (W/ Demos). The "Funny Reddit" chart has slices representing 41.5% (W/o Demos), 21.5% (Hard to Tell), and 37.1% (W/ Demos). The "Unhealthy Comments" chart has slices representing 37.8% (W/o Demos), 27.4% (Hard to Tell), and 34.8% (W/ Demos). The percentage labels are shown inside each slice, and a legend is provided at the top to distinguish between the categories. The slices are not visually emphasized or ordered in a particular way.
